fusions.name: Swarm Levy
fusions.desc: Looses 5 biting bolts at once, spread apart, each of which deals 10 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tithe Taken
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Plague Proclaimed
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm for 10 seconds that strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 2 damage every second.

fusions.name: Stripped Fields
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
